title: Warm German Almond Pilaf
description: A citrusy and indulgent German dish featuring almonds, this pilaf is perfect for a cold winter evening, simmered to perfection with a snappy texture.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds and cook until lightly toasted, stirring frequently.
Add the white rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in the butter and almond mixture.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the grated lemon zest.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
Let the pilaf rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
